text:
alice: Cutting an RC now — candidate is v2026.03.21-rc1. I pushed artefacts to s3://redwood-builds/rc/v2026.03.21-rc1. Need QA sign-off + checksum verification. @ben can you validate the package checksum?

deploy-bot: build finished: artifact=rc/v2026.03.21-rc1.tar.gz size=124MB sha256=3b7f9d8c2a1e4c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9 
logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/98765

ben: pulling now, will compare sha256. ETA 2m.

carol: starting smoke and a few critical QA paths (auth, inference endpoint, kv warm). will report results here.

alice: proposed promo window 18:00-19:00 UTC today. Canary 10% -> 50% over 10m if stable. @jordan are you available for oncall during that window?

jordan: yes, I'm oncall 17:30-19:30 UTC, will keep pager open.

ben: checksum matches: sha256 3b7f9d8c2a1e4c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9 :thumbsup:

carol: smoke pass on core flows, one minor template mismatch in admin UI (nonblocking). Captured repro and added to tracker: https://issues.redwood.ai/T-4123

dmitri: docs and release notes updated in the repo, added the migration note for kv cache warming.

alice: ok we have artefact verification + smoke pass. Holding for final sign-off from infra and prod-safety. @ben @jordan please reply with explicit sign-off so I can trigger promo.

ben: sign-off from infra: +1. verified checksum, container image tag pinned to rc1 in registry.

jordan: prod-safety/ops sign-off: +1. rollback plan and monitoring ready.

alice: great. rolling promo in 10m. small reminder of rollback instructions (copied here):

```
# rollback steps
1) scale down candidate service: /ops/scale service/api --to=0 --tag=v2026.03.21-rc1
2) switch traffic: /ops/traffic switch --route=prod --to=main-2026-03-20
3) revert database flag: /flags unset feature.new-kv-optimization
4) alert channel: #incidents and call oncall
```

carol: noted. will monitor smoke dashboards (latency, error-rate, kv-hit-rate).

deploy-bot: scheduled promote command: `/deploy promote --artifact=rc/v2026.03.21-rc1.tar.gz --target=prod --canary=10% --step=10m` executed by alice in 9m.

alice: starting promo now. initiating canary -> 10%

deploy-bot: canary started. canary endpoints: https://api-canary.redwood.ai (10% traffic). healthchecks OK so far.

carol: metrics look good at 10m mark. latency stable, error-rate within baseline. moving to 30% as planned.

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 30%. healthchecks OK.

ben: quick sanity check on database connections during shift — all green.

jordan: watching logs, no pager noise.

alice: promoting to 100% in 15m if no regressions. please call abort ASAP if you see anything.

carol: flagged a flaky UI template only on a rare 404 path — not seen in smoke. will patch post-promote, not a blocker.

deploy-bot: promotion completed: 100% traffic on v2026.03.21-rc1. rollout time 00:22:17.

alice: promo complete. release note short: "v2026.03.21-rc1 — production rollout: kv cache improvements, latency optimizations, small admin UI fix pending." I'll follow up with a fuller release note later.

ben: rolling post-promote checks now. all signed off from my side.

jordan: oncall clear. no incidents.

alice: thanks everyone. tagging for audit: @carol @ben @jordan @dmitri :white_check_mark:

carol: leaving a short postmortem checklist in the release doc for tracking the admin UI patch and the QA flaky-404 item.

ben: thumbs up. moving pinned artifact to stable registry tag `stable-2026.03.21` as follow-up.

deploy-bot: action log: promote succeeded, pinned registry tag stable-2026.03.21 created.

alice: closing thread. great job team.
